summary: The agent failed because it manually extracted data from images instead of using OCR automation, incorrectly nulled out 16/20 rows as 'duplicates' when the task likely expected all rows preserved, and formatted prices with fixed 2 decimal places violating the precision rule. This patch extends the existing image-data-extraction skill to cover order/invoice extraction with proper patterns, reference file validation, and explicit anti-patterns against manual extraction and incorrect deduplication.
